title: MotionCFG: Boosting Motion Dynamics via Semantic Motion Sharpening
abstract: arXiv:2603.14073v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite recent advancements in Text-to-Video (T2V) synthesis, generating high-fidelity and dynamic motion remains a significant challenge. Existing methods primarily rely on Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), but standard CFG treats all semantic dimensions uniformly and provides no mechanism to selectively resolve ambiguity along the motion axis. To address this, we propose MotionCFG, a training-free approach that introduces selective guidance along the motion subspace of the condition embedding. Specifically, we construct a motion-perturbed negative condition by injecting Gaussian noise into motion-related embeddings, and steer generation away from it to selectively amplify motion intent. We show theoretically that this procedure implicitly approximates Semantic Laplacian Sharpening, a second-order correction that suppresses motion-ambiguous regions of the score landscape and amplifies well-resolved dynamic peaks. translated_title: MotionCFG：通过语义运动锐化提升视频运动动态性
translated_abstract: 尽管文本到视频（T2V）合成技术近期取得了进展，但生成高保真且富有动态感的运动仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法主要依赖于无分类器引导（Classifier-Free Guidance, CFG），但标准的CFG对所有语义维度进行统一处理，缺乏沿运动轴选择性消除歧义的机制。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MotionCFG，这是一种无需训练的方法，它在条件嵌入的运动子空间中引入选择性引导。具体而言，我们通过向运动相关嵌入注入高斯噪声来构建一个运动扰动的负向条件，并引导生成过程远离该条件，从而选择性地放大运动意图。我们从理论上证明，该过程隐式地近似于语义拉普拉斯锐化（Semantic Laplacian Sharpening），这是一种二阶修正，能够抑制分数空间中运动模糊的区域，并放大清晰可辨的动态峰值。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了无需训练的MotionCFG方法，通过在条件嵌入的运动子空间注入高斯噪声构建运动扰动负向条件并引导生成远离它，实现语义拉普拉斯锐化，从而选择性地增强文本到视频生成中的运动动态性。
en_tdlr: MotionCFG is a training-free method that boosts motion dynamics in text-to-video generation by injecting Gaussian noise into motion-related embeddings to construct a motion-perturbed negative condition and steering generation away from it, which implicitly approximates Semantic Laplacian Sharpening to selectively amplify motion intent.
